name: Nine-herb preparation (bitter candytuft combination)
short: A review reported adverse drug reactions in 0.04% across various studies, but a case report describes severe acute hepatitis and notes occasional liver-injury cases. No interaction data were found.
text: A review summarising 12 clinical trials reported that, across various studies, the incidence of adverse drug reactions with this preparation was 0.04%. Case reports nevertheless describe liver injury: in one, a 32-year-old woman developed severe acute hepatitis with jaundice that resolved 5 weeks after she stopped the product, and the authors noted that occasional cases of drug-induced liver injury have been documented. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
